_comment: Hand-written default results, merged over the generated ones by tools/build-server-data.py. Keys are 'Class.method' as sent by the game. Add entries here when the real app needs a different shape than the model-based default (see Unity exceptions in logcat).
_league: LeagueWeekly.getRank: as in SSGF (LOONA's LeagueWeeklyInfo and LeagueWeeklyInfo.Ranking have the same fields, 15 league classes as well): the player's own entry in the weekly ranking (the server fills in name and leader card) and lastWeekAverage for every league class.
_news: Promotion.getNewsData: the lobby news banner, as in SSOMG/SSGF, but LOONA's News model has no [JsonProperty] names, so the fields go by their C# names (index, external, timeStartAt, timeEndAt instead of orderIndex, externalUrl, startAt, endAt). Listed for targetLanguage 0 and 1 (Korean build vs. other languages).
